lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: Hospitality Management ka pala, {name}! May malaking catering order ako para sa barangay seminar — tulungan mo ako sa plating at service, doble ang tip!
lines.textEn: Hospitality Management major, {name}! I landed a big barangay catering order — help me with plating and service for double pay!

choices.text: Akin na ang apron, Aling Nena! (Play Carinderia Rush)
choices.textEn: Hand me the apron, Aling Nena! (Play Carinderia Rush)
